language.label: Language
language.description: The language of the overlay. System default follows your system language. Item names, stats and game terms stay in English, as in the game.

chatButton.label: Chat Button Overlay
chatButton.description: Show the floating chat button overlay in the bottom-right corner of the screen.

windowTransparency.label: Window transparency: <num>{{value}}%</num>
windowTransparency.description: See the game through window backgrounds. 0% is fully opaque.

enabled.label: Corrupted zone timer
enabled.description: Show which zones new Hell games corrupt and the time until the next rotation (every 15 minutes). Click it for the upcoming zones.

position.label: Timer position
position.description: Pin the timer to a corner of the game, or drag it anywhere on screen (switches to Custom).

zones.label: Timer shows
zones.description: Every zone, or only the zones you follow: the timer then counts down to the next one and lists only those (every zone while you follow none).

alerts.label: Zone notifications
alerts.description: Pop up a toast when the corrupted zone changes: for every new zone, or only the zones you follow. Toasts follow the Toast Popups switch in Chat settings.

followed.label: Followed zones
followed.description: The zones the timer and notifications follow when set to Only zones I follow.
